From that <term>utpala</term> <gloss>blue lotus</gloss> arises the blue Tara, with two hands. Her right hand holds a <term>trishula</term> <gloss>trident</gloss>, and her left hand holds an <term>utpala</term> with a stem. Her beautiful body is adorned with precious necklaces, earrings, armlets, and various kinds of ornaments. She is in the bloom of youth, with a smiling face, and she sits upon a moon and lotus in the posture of equal meditation. In the south, upon a moon and lotus, from the syllable <term>re</term> arises a yellow <term>utpala</term> with its seed, which pervades the entire realm of the world. Through lights of various colors, the entire world is seen as an emanation, like an illusion, a rainbow, a mirage, a reflection of the moon in water, or an image. Her beautiful body is adorned with precious necklaces, earrings, armlets, and various kinds of ornaments. From that <term>utpala</term> arises the Hook Tara, white in body color, with two hands holding a hook. Her body is wrathful, adorned with precious necklaces, earrings, armlets, and various kinds of ornaments. She is in the bloom of youth, with a slightly wrathful face, and she sits upon a moon and lotus with one leg extended and one bent.
